company.name: DMR Analytics
company.shortDescription: DMR Analytics develops AI-powered software that converts oil and gas drilling morning reports into structured, analyzable data.
company.description: DMR Analytics develops software solutions for the oil and gas industry focused on transforming drilling and workover morning reports into structured digital datasets. The platform uses AI to extract operational information from unstructured PDF reports and convert it into organized formats such as Excel files for analysis. It supports data extraction across fields including rig activity, safety logs, equipment details, and well performance metrics. The system is designed to enable faster reporting, data analysis, and operational decision-making for drilling and engineering teams.

productsAndServices.description: A software solution designed for the Oil and Gas industry to analyze data, manage operations, and assess performance for informed decision-making.
